line: A storm at Parkes, 21 July 1969: a 64-metre dish tipped to its limit holds on and catches the moonwalk for the world.
line_cn: 1969 年 7 月 21 日帕克斯的风暴里，一面放倒到极限的 64 米天线顶住了风，替全世界接住了登月直播。

transitions: Transitions belong to the medium: a scan that rewrites the scene in place;
a scan wipe between two live views (two renders, a 1 px bright edge sweeping, the next view behind it);
a hard cut on an impact;
a match cut from one rectangle or circle to another (a monitor's screen into the picture it shows);
labels: Title: a thin humanist sans (IBM Plex Sans 200 in the demo), 50–70 px, sentence case, never centred, no shadow or outline.
Readings and labels: a light monospace (JetBrains Mono 300), 14–17 px, all caps, tracked +1.2 to +2.4 px; big numbers (a time, an angle, a ratio) in the thin sans at 50–150 px.
Chinese (Noto Sans SC Light): one short line under the title or as a section label, ≥ 34 px.
Every text is written by a scan bar: a clip that grows left to right with a 1 px bright edge leading. No typewriter, no fade-in, no pop.
motion: The scan advances in surges on the beat (an ease-out push per beat, mixed with a steady drift so it never stops dead). Its speed is the film's pulse.
Machines move with weight: anticipation, a long ease, a bounce against the stop, and a wireframe after-image trail while moving.
Weather, when a film has it (wind, rain, dust), moves continuously and slants with the gusts; the camera shakes only with the weather, more in close-ups.

native_moves.name: The scan reveal
native_moves.does: black → a light plane sweeps → the subject exists → it settles into echoes.

native_moves.name: Sky behind the beam
native_moves.does: stars and the Milky Way appear only where the scan has passed.

native_moves.name: Scan rewrites time
native_moves.does: in one shot, a second scan replaces night with day (or one state with another) and erases the old labels as it passes.

native_moves.name: Motion echo
native_moves.does: wireframe after-images left behind by a moving machine.

native_moves.name: Radial ping
native_moves.does: the subject becomes the source; a ring of light runs out across the ground and the range rings flash.

native_moves.name: Instrument readouts written by the scan
native_moves.does: an angle counting to its limit on an arc; a trace crossing one threshold line; a comparison held still (one quantity beside another).

native_moves.name: Scan line = TV raster
native_moves.does: a picture written line by line, rough at first and sharpening as the lines fill in.

native_moves.name: CRT to scan
native_moves.does: the picture collapses into a line, and the line is the next shot's scan light.
